Élévation de privilèges

In this glossary, Élévation de privilèges refers to: The process by which a threat actor gains unauthorized elevated access rights within cryptographic or PKI systems.

Definition

The process by which a threat actor gains unauthorized elevated access rights within cryptographic or PKI systems.

Operational example

Privilege escalation in PKI environments may allow attackers to compromise certificate authority functions or modify trust anchors.
